newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Nov 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Nov 29.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories in its Friday editions:
- Senior Volkswagen executive Jose Ignacio Lopez is expected to resign after fighting charges that he stole secret documents from General Motors Corp.
- Insurance investment and research concern Conning & Co says home insurers have been losing money because they have been expanding benefits and taking on additional risk without increasing prices.
- Chief executive officer Lukas Muhlemann plans to reorganize Credit Suisse.
- Marriott International Inc and Host Marriott Corp are thriving after Marriott was split up three years ago.
- Elf Aquitaine is attracting U.S. investor interest after shedding its image as a state company unfamiliar with a competitive market.
- Striking French truck drivers refused to dismantle barricades blocking the country's main roads.
- American Skiing is promoting as a group the seven New England ski resorts that it owns.
- Nigeria's military leader is trying to make economic changes in the country as well as improve his image.
